meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按调试指南排查容器代理问题:定位日志、查询会话数据库、检查挂载配置,并针对重复实例、认证失败等常见故障给出修复步骤。
howto.when: 当出现不工作、容器失败、认证问题等情况,或想了解容器系统工作原理时触发。

say.text: 容器启动后立刻退出,没有回复,怎么查?
say.note: Claude 会指导查看日志和会话数据库。

say.text: 消息显示已送达但用户没收到,可能是什么原因?
say.note: 检查是否有重复实例和适配器问题。

say.text: 容器里调用 API 返回 401,如何排查认证?
say.note: 查看 onecli 的 secretMode 和网关状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows the debugging guide to troubleshoot container agent issues: locating logs, querying session DBs, checking mounts, and providing fixes for duplicate instances, auth failures, and other common problems.
howto.when_en: Triggered when things aren't working, containers fail, authentication problems occur, or to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: Container exits immediately with no reply. How do I diagnose?
say_en.note: Guides you through logs and session DBs.

say_en.text: Message shows delivered but user never got it. Why?
say_en.note: Checks for duplicate instances and adapters.

say_en.text: API call inside container returns 401. How to debug auth?
say_en.note: Inspects onecli secret mode and gateway.
